name: Amnon
summary: The firstborn son of David, born in Hebron. He forced his sister Tamar, and two years later her brother Absalom had him killed.

key_moments.title: Forces His Sister Tamar
key_moments.description: Amnon pretended to be sick so that his sister Tamar would come and bake cakes for him. He forced her, then hated her and sent her away.

key_moments.title: Killed at Absalom's Feast
key_moments.description: Two years later Absalom invited the king's sons to his sheepshearing at Baal-hazor. When Amnon was merry with wine, Absalom's servants killed him at Absalom's command.
